caption: The drawing depicts a single antique armchair positioned in the center of a plain, light beige background. The chair has a wooden frame with a dark reddish-brown color and ornate curves on the legs, arms, and top back, accompanying decorative carvings. Both the seat and the oval-shaped backrest are upholstered in a light beige fabric featuring a subtle floral pattern with touches of pale yellow and gray. The armrests are partially padded with the same fabric and have wooden supports. The chair is shown at a slight angle, giving visibility to both the front and right side. There are no other objects in the composition, and the artist's signature, "Edna Reps," is written at the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
